bundle.shortDescription: Music-making app to start with a MIDI keyboard
bundle.longDescription:
meloet is a DAW for people who have just got a MIDI keyboard. Plug in
the keyboard and play: meloet records what you play, and you can fix the
notes in the piano roll, arrange the clips, mix the tracks and export
the song as an audio file. The instrument sounds (about 240 MB) are
downloaded from GitHub the first time, when you say yes. VST3 and LV2
plugins can also be used.
